title: Albin Countergambit: the Lasker Trap
line: A pawn marches to the last rank and becomes a knight, with check.

steps.text: The Albin Countergambit. White strikes at your wedged pawn with the king pawn at once. That is a mistake.
Check with the bishop. White has to spend a move answering it.
steps.after: White blocks with the bishop, which attacks yours.

steps.text: Take the pawn on e3. Let White take your bishop.
steps.after: White takes the bishop and falls into the trap.
The king steps up. Taking the pawn would drop the queen on d1. Your pawn on f2 can take the knight on g1.

steps.text: Take the knight and make your pawn a knight. A knight there gives check, and a queen would not.

wrong.f2g1q: A queen gives no check there, so White has time to check first and then take her.

steps.hint: A pawn on the last rank can become any piece. Pick the one that gives check.
steps.after: The rook takes the knight. Now the king and queen stand on one diagonal.

steps.text: Check with the bishop. Behind the king stands the queen.
steps.after: The king must move, and the bishop takes the queen.

summary: A pawn that reaches the last rank can become a knight. Here the knight gives check where a queen would not.
